posts.text:
2026, over and out 🤯
-
Our final round at Jerez was a tough one. A tricky Friday resulted in making both races difficult, but managed to pull out some good points. Always try to make the most, with learning more about the circuit and its characteristics, how it affects the bike. I feel it’s set us in a great place for next year. 
-
It seems absolutely surreal this season has come to end, but what an experience it’s been. At the start, I didn’t really have any expectations for results or championship position. But to have achieved 2 podiums, top 10’s and 12th in the championship on debut is a fantastic achievement. 
-
I think it’s important to notice the incredible job the PHR Performance team have done this year. At the level we are competing at, we’ve done incredibly well with our results and performance across this season. 
-
A massive thank you to my amazing sponsors for making this year possible. It’s been a pleasure to have these people supporting throughout the year, and cannot wait for the next 😈. 
-
And a final thank you to Peter Hickman for putting together this incredible team and the opportunity to race at World Superbikes. Let’s keep working into 2027 💪🏻
-

Day 2 ✅
Race 1: P7 
-
A good result pulled today from 22nd on the grid. Just out of touch from the leading group, I was happy with how I progressed through the field during the race. 
-
I felt I made a good step in understanding the bike at the track and in these types of conditions, which I’m happy with! 
-
All to play for tomorrow, excited for our final race of the season 😁
